blocks.text: Dennis Trillo’s son Calix and Beauty Gonzalez’s daughter Olivia are officially taking their first steps into the entertainment industry after signing with talent management agency Aguila Entertainment. The agency welcomed the two celebrity children through separate announcement posts on its Facebook page on Sunday, Nov. 8. In its announcement, Aguila Entertainment said the 19-year-old Calix intends to begin his showbiz career through commercial projects and brand collaborations, including key opinion leader (KOL) engagements. “Just like his father Dennis Trillo, Calix wants to start off his showbiz career by doing commercials and working with brands for KOL engagements,” the agency said.
